claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve supports absolute and improvement prompt reward modes, finite prompt reward bounds, normalized prompt reward metadata, prompt reward policy replay compatibility checks, UCB-style prompt-arm selection, bounded meta-prompt performance evidence, prompt-history reward events, latest-candidate prompt reward evidence, and score-composition inputs to prompt rewards. It does not claim calibrated prompt reward signals, prompt-lineage ablation reports, prompt-policy effect attribution, parent-program noise controls, evaluator noise controls, or equal-budget prompt-policy comparisons.
source_claim: AlphaEvolve co-evolves prompt instructions and context; prompt updates should be justified by calibrated evidence that separates prompt-policy effects from program, parent, and evaluator noise
